description: This file declares an abstract class 'CvdCommandHandler' which defines an interface for handling various command requests within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes methods for checking if a command can be handled, executing commands, listing subcommands, and providing help text.

classes.name: CvdCommandHandler
classes.description: An abstract interface for command handlers within the 'cuttlefish' namespace, defining methods for command handling, subcommand listing, and help documentation.

methods.name: CanHandle
methods.description: Checks if the command handler can process the given command request.

methods.name: CmdList
methods.description: Returns a list of subcommands that this handler can process.

methods.name: SummaryHelp
methods.description: Provides a brief help summary of the command.

methods.name: DetailedHelp
methods.description: Provides detailed help information for the command.

methods.name: ShouldInterceptHelp
methods.description: Indicates if help commands should be intercepted or handled specially.
